title: Psalms 76
paragraphs: ¹ God is known in Judah; his name is great in Israel. ² His tent is in Salem; his dwelling place is in Zion. ³ There he broke the flashing arrows, the shields and the swords and the weapons of war. Selah. ⁴ You are radiant with light, more majestic than mountains rich with game. ⁵ The brave soldiers have been stripped and sunk into the sleep of death; not one of those warriors could lift a hand.

⁶ At your rebuke, O God of Jacob, both horse and chariot lie still. ⁷ It is you alone who are to be feared. Who can stand before you when once you are angry? ⁸ From heaven you announced judgment; the earth feared and was still ⁹ when God arose to judge, to save all the humble of the earth. Selah. ¹⁰ Human wrath will bring you praise; with the remnant of wrath you will arm yourself.
¹¹ Make your vows to the LORD your God and keep them; let all who are around him bring gifts to the one to be feared. ¹² He breaks the spirit of rulers; he is feared by the kings of the earth.
